title: Oven Roasted Vietnamese Tofu Bowl
description: A savory and crunchy Vietnamese dish featuring shaoxing wine and shio-cure, served in a dolsot-stone-bowl, perfect for a solo dinner.

ingredients.name: extra firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into 1 inch cubes

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together shaoxing wine, shio-cure, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil.
Add the cubed tofu to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Let the tofu marinate for at least 10 minutes.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the marinated tofu in a single layer.
Roast the tofu in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, flipping halfway through.
While the tofu is roasting, heat a small saucepan over medium heat and add the minced garlic and grated ginger.
Cook the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, until fragrant.
To assemble the bowl, place a portion of the roasted tofu in the dolsot-stone-bowl, followed by a spoonful of the garlic and ginger mixture, and top with mixed greens and pickled carrots.
